_doc: Āryabhaṭa's table of 24 sine differences (Āryabhaṭīya, Gītikāpada verse 12), in arcminutes, for arcs in steps of 3°45′ in a circle of radius 3438′. Running sums give the tabulated jyā (half-chord) values; the 24 differences sum to 3438, the radius. Drawn as a line in AryabhataScene.
source: Āryabhaṭīya, Gītikāpada 12; see K. S. Shukla & K. V. Sarma (1976) and Plofker, Mathematics in India (2009).
